prompt: Which statements about diagnosing failed runs are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Annotations, selective re-runs, and debug logging are the diagnosis loop. Run history outlives the workflow file, and plenty of failures come from the code or environment on a perfectly valid workflow.

options.text: Annotations on the run page summarize detected errors and link into the logs
Re-run failed jobs repeats only the combinations that failed
Runner debug logs can be enabled for a re-run when the normal logs are not enough
Deleting the workflow file deletes its run history
A failed job always means the workflow YAML itself is invalid
